text_en: He was praying in a certain place, and after he had finished, one of his disciples said to him, “Lord, teach us to pray, as John taught his disciples. ”
text_cn: 有一次，耶稣在一个地方祈祷，停止以后，他的一个门徒对他说：“主，请教给我们祈祷，如同若翰教给了他的门徒一样。”

text_en: He said to them, “When you pray, say: Father, hallowed be your name. Your kingdom come.
text_cn: 耶稣给他们说：“你们祈祷时要说：父啊！愿你的名被尊为圣！愿你的国来临！

text_en: Give us each day our daily bread.
text_cn: 我们的日用粮，求你天天赐给我们！

text_en: And forgive us our sins, for we ourselves forgive everyone indebted to us. And do not bring us to the time of trial. ”
text_cn: 宽免我们的罪过，因为我们自己也宽免所有亏负我们的人；不要让我们陷入诱惑。”

text_en: And he said to them, “Suppose one of you has a friend, and you go to him at midnight and say to him, ‘Friend, lend me three loaves of bread;
text_cn: 耶稣对他们说：“你们中间谁有一个朋友，半夜去他那里，给他说：朋友，借给我三个饼罢！

text_en: for a friend of mine has arrived, and I have nothing to set before him. ’
text_cn: 因为我的朋友行路到了我这里，我没有什么可以款待他。

text_en: And he answers from within, ‘Do not bother me; the door has already been locked, and my children are with me in bed; I cannot get up and give you anything. ’
text_cn: 那人从里面回答说：不要烦扰我了！门已经关上，我的孩子们同我一起在床上，我不能起来给你。

text_en: I tell you, even though he will not get up and give him anything because he is his friend, at least because of his persistence he will get up and give him whatever he needs.
text_cn: 我告诉你们：他纵然不为了他是朋友的原故，而起来给他，也要因他恬不知耻地切求而起来，给他所需要的一切。

text_en: “So I say to you, Ask, and it will be given you; search, and you will find; knock, and the door will be opened for you.
text_cn: 所以，我告诉你们：你们求，必要给你们；你们找，必要找着；你们敲，必要给你们开。

text_en: For everyone who asks receives, and everyone who searches finds, and for everyone who knocks, the door will be opened.
text_cn: 因为凡求的，就必得到；找的，就必找到；敲的，就必给他开。

text_en: Is there anyone among you who, if your child asks for a fish, will give a snake instead of a fish?
text_cn: 你们中间哪有为父亲的，儿子向他求饼，反而给他石头呢？或是求鱼，反将蛇当鱼给他呢？

text_en: Or if the child asks for an egg, will give a scorpion?
text_cn: 或者求鸡蛋，反将蝎子给他呢？

text_en: If you then, who are evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will the heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him! ”
text_cn: 你们纵然不善，尚且知道把好东西给你们的儿女，何况在天之父，有不更将圣神赐与求他的人吗？”

text_en: Now he was casting out a demon that was mute; when the demon had gone out, the one who had been mute spoke, and the crowds were amazed.
text_cn: 耶稣驱逐一个魔鬼──他是使人喑 （yīn）哑的魔鬼；他出去以后，哑巴便说出话来，群众都惊讶不止。

text_en: But some of them said, “He casts out demons by Beelzebul, the ruler of the demons. ”
text_cn: 但是，其中有人说：“他是仗赖魔王贝耳则步驱魔。”

text_en: Others, to test him, kept demanding from him a sign from heaven.
text_cn: 另一些人试探耶稣，向他要求一个自天而来的征兆。

text_en: But he knew what they were thinking and said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself becomes a desert, and house falls on house.
text_cn: 耶稣知道了他们的心意，便给他们说：“凡是一国自相纷争，必成废墟，一家一家的败落。

text_en: If Satan also is divided against himself, how will his kingdom stand? —for you say that I cast out the demons by Beelzebul.
text_cn: 如果撒殚自相纷争，他的国如何能存立呢？因为你们说我仗赖贝耳则步驱魔。

text_en: Now if I cast out the demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your exorcists cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.
text_cn: 如果我仗赖贝耳则步驱魔，你们的子弟们是仗赖谁驱魔呢？为此，他们将是你们的裁判者。

text_en: But if it is by the finger of God that I cast out the demons, then the kingdom of God has come to you.
text_cn: 如果我是仗赖天主的手指驱魔，那么，天主的国已来到你们中间了。

text_en: When a strong man, fully armed, guards his castle, his property is safe.
text_cn: 几时壮士佩带武器，看守自己的宅舍，他的财产，必能安全。

text_en: But when one stronger than he attacks him and overpowers him, he takes away his armor in which he trusted and divides his plunder.
text_cn: 但是，如果有个比他强壮的来战胜他，必会把他所依仗的一切器械都夺去，而瓜分他的赃物。

text_en: Whoever is not with me is against me, and whoever does not gather with me scatters.
text_cn: 不随同我的，就是反对我；不同我收集的，就是分散。”

text_en: “When the unclean spirit has gone out of a person, it wanders through waterless regions looking for a resting place, but not finding any, it says, ‘I will return to my house from which I came. ’
text_cn: “邪魔从人身上出去后，走遍干旱之地，寻找一个安息之所，却没有找着；他于是说：我要回到我出来的那屋里去。

text_en: When it comes, it finds it swept and put in order.
text_cn: 他来到后，见里面已打扫清洁，装饰整齐，

text_en: Then it goes and brings seven other spirits more evil than itself, and they enter and live there; and the last state of that person is worse than the first. ”
text_cn: 就去，另外带了七个比自己更恶的魔鬼来，进去，住在那里；那人末后的处境，比先前就更坏了。”

text_en: While he was saying this, a woman in the crowd raised her voice and said to him, “Blessed is the womb that bore you and the breasts that nursed you! ”
text_cn: 耶稣说这些话的时候，人群中，有一个妇人高声向他说：“怀过你的胎，及你所吮吸过的乳房，是有福的！”

text_en: But he said, “Blessed rather are those who hear the word of God and obey it! ”
text_cn: 耶稣却说：“可是那听天主的话而遵行的人，更是有福的！”

text_en: When the crowds were increasing, he began to say, “This generation is an evil generation; it asks for a sign, but no sign will be given to it except the sign of Jonah.
text_cn: 群众集合拢来的时候，耶稣开始说：“这一世代是一邪恶的世代：它要求征兆，除了约纳的征兆外，必不给它任何其他征兆。

text_en: For just as Jonah became a sign to the people of Nineveh, so the Son of Man will be to this generation.
text_cn: 因为，有如约纳为尼尼微人是个征兆，将来人子为这一世代也是这样。

text_en: The queen of the South will rise at the judgment with the people of this generation and condemn them, because she came from the ends of the earth to listen to the wisdom of Solomon, and see, something greater than Solomon is here!
text_cn: 南方的女王，在审判时，将同这一代人起来，定他们的罪，因为她从地极来，听撒罗满的智慧；看，这里有一位大于撒罗满的！

text_en: The people of Nineveh will rise up at the judgment with this generation and condemn it, because they repented at the proclamation of Jonah, and see, something greater than Jonah is here!
text_cn: 尼尼微人在审判时，将同这一代人起来，定他们的罪，因为尼尼微人因了约纳的宣讲而悔改了；看，这里有一位大于约纳的！”

text_en: “No one after lighting a lamp puts it in a cellar, but on the lampstand so that those who enter may see the light.
text_cn: “没有人点灯放在窖中，或置于斗下的，而是放在灯台上，让进来的人看见光明。

text_en: Your eye is the lamp of your body. If your eye is healthy, your whole body is full of light; but if it is not healthy, your body is full of darkness.
text_cn: 你的眼睛就是身体的灯。几时你的眼睛纯洁，你全身就光明；但如果邪恶，你全身就黑暗。

text_en: Therefore consider whether the light in you is not darkness.
text_cn: 为此，你要小心，不要叫你内里的光成了黑暗。

text_en: If then your whole body is full of light, with no part of it in darkness, it will be as full of light as when a lamp gives you light with its rays. ”
text_cn: 所以，如果你全身光明，丝毫没有黑暗之处，一切必要光明，有如灯光照耀你一样。”

text_en: While he was speaking, a Pharisee invited him to dine with him; so he went in and took his place at the table.
text_cn: 耶稣正说话的时候，有一个法利塞人请他到自己家中用饭，耶稣进去便入了席。

text_en: The Pharisee was amazed to see that he did not first wash before dinner.
text_cn: 那个法利塞人一看见，就怪异耶稣饭前不先洗手。

text_en: Then the Lord said to him, “Now you Pharisees clean the outside of the cup and of the dish, but inside you are full of greed and wickedness.
text_cn: 但主对他说：“你们法利塞人洗净杯盘的外面，你们心中却满是劫夺与邪恶。

text_en: You fools! Did not the one who made the outside make the inside also?
text_cn: 糊涂人哪！那造外面的，不是也造了里面吗？

text_en: So give for alms those things that are within; and see, everything will be clean for you.
text_cn: 只要把你们杯盘里面的施舍了，那么，一切对你们便都洁净了。

text_en: “But woe to you Pharisees! For you tithe mint and rue and herbs of all kinds, and neglect justice and the love of God; it is these you ought to have practiced, without neglecting the others.
text_cn: 但是，祸哉，你们法利塞人！因为你们把薄荷、茴香及各种菜蔬捐献十分之一，反而将公义及爱天主的义务忽略过去：这些固然该作，那些也不可忽略。

text_en: Woe to you Pharisees! For you love to have the seat of honor in the synagogues and to be greeted with respect in the marketplaces.
text_cn: 祸哉，你们法利塞人！因为你们在会堂里爱坐上座，在街市上爱受人致敬。

text_en: Woe to you! For you are like unmarked graves, and people walk over them without realizing it. ”
text_cn: 祸哉，你们！因为你们就如同不显露的坟墓，人在上面行走，也不知道。”

text_en: One of the lawyers answered him, “Teacher, when you say these things, you insult us too. ”
text_cn: 有一个法学士回答耶稣说：“师傅，你说这些话，连我们也侮辱了。”

text_en: And he said, “Woe also to you lawyers! For you load people with burdens hard to bear, and you yourselves do not lift a finger to ease them.
text_cn: 耶稣说：“祸哉，你们这些法学士！因为你们加给人不堪负荷的重担，而你们自己对重担连一个指头也不肯动一下。

text_en: Woe to you! For you build the tombs of the prophets whom your ancestors killed.
text_cn: 祸哉，你们！你们修建先知的坟墓，而你们的祖先却杀害了他们，

text_en: So you are witnesses and approve of the deeds of your ancestors; for they killed them, and you build their tombs.
text_cn: 可见你们证明，并且赞成你们祖先所行的事，因为他们杀害了先知，而你们却修建先知的坟墓。

text_en: Therefore also the Wisdom of God said, ‘I will send them prophets and apostles, some of whom they will kill and persecute, ’
text_cn: 为此，天主的智慧曾说过：我将要派遣先知及使者到他们那里，其中有的，他们要杀死；有的，他们要迫害，

text_en: so that this generation may be charged with the blood of all the prophets shed since the foundation of the world,
text_cn: 为使从创造世界以来，所流众先知的血，都要向这一代追讨，

text_en: from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zechariah, who perished between the altar and the sanctuary. Yes, I tell you, it will be charged against this generation.
text_cn: 从亚伯尔的血，到丧亡在祭坛与圣所之间的则加黎雅的血，的确，我告诉你们：都要向这一代追讨。

text_en: Woe to you lawyers! For you have taken away the key of knowledge; you did not enter yourselves, and you hindered those who were entering. ”
text_cn: 祸哉，你们法学士！因为你们拿走了智慧的钥匙，自己不进去，那愿意进去的，你们也加以阻止。”

text_en: When he went outside, the scribes and the Pharisees began to be very hostile toward him and to cross-examine him about many things,
text_cn: 耶稣从那里出来以后，经师们及法利塞人开始严厉追逼他，盘问他许多的事，

text_en: lying in wait for him, to catch him in something he might say.
text_cn: 窥伺他，要从他口中抓到语病。
